Hongdae Cafe, ㅎㄷ Cafe.

The strawberry latte, one of the signatures, had a taste that emphasized the sour taste of the seeds rather than the sweetness, perhaps because it was out of season. The taste was ordinary.
Lemon Yogurt Dacquoise tastes like you've tried it somewhere before. The outside tastes like a cookie sabre. The taste is okay.
The tangerine fresh cream cake lacked the depth of fresh cream flavor. This is also normal.

Each floor has a theme. Just go upstairs, order a drink, and wander around.

The rooftop is also nice to look around. It's okay because there's some shade at dusk.

Among the dessert cafes in Hongdae, this place has the best crepes! The crepes were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the seasonal ingredients, such as strawberries, were fresh and delicious.

The drinks also exceeded expectations! Danbi Latte has a sweet and clean taste, so it goes well with desserts.
The store is relatively small, but it has a cozy and emotional atmosphere, making it great for taking pictures.

However, there may be a wait on weekends and there are not many seats, so it is better to leave some time to spare.
Overall, this cafe is highly recommended for dessert lovers! 😄

reviews.author: DovewinG
reviews.text:
The cafe is located in a narrow alley and is on the 3rd floor. Accessibility is a bit disappointing, but the atmosphere is cozy and warm and the owner makes a very good impression.
The dessert was strawberry pavlova. This was the most delicious. I'll have to try something else next time.
For tea, I drank Schisandra chinensis tea and Ogamcha. The Schisandra chinensis tea had the neat taste of a slightly sour tea, and the Ogamcha tea had a warm and calming grain tea. Drink it calmly and leave.

​"A Cozy Hidden Gem with Amazing Desserts!"
​This cafe is tucked away in a narrow alley on the 3rd floor, so the accessibility isn't the best—but it is definitely worth the climb. The atmosphere is incredibly cozy and warm, and the owner is exceptionally kind and welcoming.
​For dessert, the Strawberry Pavlova was the absolute highlight. It was delicious! I’m already looking forward to trying their other treats next time.
​As for the drinks, I had the Omija (Magnolia Berry) Tea and Ogam Tea.
​1. The Omija Tea had a clean, refined taste with a lovely hint of tartness.
​2. The Ogam Tea was a warm, calming grain-based tea that felt very soothing.
​It was such a peaceful and relaxing experience. Highly recommended!

2025.10.31 First visit

A store that sells crepes for meals (crepes filled with meat, French fries, etc.) and crepes for dessert (crepes made with commonly known fruits and whipped cream).

First of all, there is a kiosk in the store, but it is turned off. You can guess the reason, explained later.

When I went in to eat crepes for dessert, they suddenly told me to buy the most expensive crepes among the meal crepes, saying it was their store's signature product. Even when I asked for a crepe for dessert, they recommended it again, so I ordered it out of curiosity.

The store owner speaks English. I think I have some experience, but given that I am not good at Korean, I think it is because of the above description. I think there are many people who suffered without knowing anything. Looking at reviews on other sites, there was even a story that even though I was in the same situation, when I told them about the small size of the crepe for dessert, they kept telling me to buy the larger size. It's really the worst.

This was my first time eating crepes for a meal, so other than the fact that they were fresh, they were the worst. The food itself is not recommended as it is a calorie bomb and is full of carbohydrates.

reviews.author: 88 SEOUL
reviews.text:
Today, while looking for a slightly unique dessert in Hongdae, I went to Mysterious Confectionery Shop.

You can find Mysterious Confectionery Shop near Hongik University Station on Line 2 or Gyeongui Line or Sangsu Station on Line 6, or along Wausan-ro 29na-gil inside the alley.

The moment I entered the store, I was immediately struck by the ‘magical atmosphere’ that was different from regular snack shops. The walls, shelves, and lighting all had a unique and cute feel, so I thought, “It’s a great place to take pictures during a Hongdae date or friend gathering.”

Inside the store, there were a variety of snacks on display that are hard to find in supermarkets or convenience stores.

Candy and jellies imported directly from overseas

Domestic snacks with an old-fashioned feel (including snacks I ate as a child)

Unique visual snack & snack set

Simple ice cream/snacks

It was really fun to look around because there were a lot of snacks that are hard to find. In particular, I feel happy when I stumble upon “nostalgic snacks” and ask my friends, “Did you eat these when you were young?” There were moments when I laughed.

I chose a few snacks, and the ones that stayed in my memory for a long time were a bag of old snacks and foreign jellies. When I got home and opened it, the color, scent, and taste of the snacks exceeded my expectations, and I thought, “There were snacks like this too!” I had a happy feeling.

The atmosphere wasn't too burdensome, and the prices didn't feel excessive for a snack shop. So, I thought it was good for “a good dessert shop to stop by when you’re feeling low on sugar,” “a good place to buy snacks after shopping,” and “date + snack + recall memories.”

If you want to shop for some unique snacks or snacks around Hongdae - Mysterious Snack Shop, I was quite satisfied. It's worth a visit.

reviews.author: Soomin Park
reviews.text:
The gelato burger is really delicious! Sweet gelato in a warm bun...! I had been saving this place for a while because I wanted to try a gelato burger, and I finally visited it! I chose the yogurt and chocolate flavored gelato, and it was refreshingly sweet and had a strong chocolate flavor, so it was really delicious. I recommend it!
The rice burger was also delicious. It tasted as delicious as you can imagine, but it was also addictive! Unlike other rice burgers that replace the patty with real rice, the bun was filled with rice and delicious fillings, making it even more delicious! I tried kimchi tuna and anchovy flavors and both were successful...!!! Hahaha
This time, the owner introduced a new product = Yakgwa + donut, so I tried it. It has a rich yakgwa flavor and is thick and dense, so if you like sweets like me, you will really enjoy it!
It's good value for money and the owner is so kind that I think I'll remember it often~!!

reviews.text:
⭐ Atmosphere: 9/10
⭐ Food: 9.5/10
⭐ Service: 9/10

Located at 24 Wausan-ro 21-gil, Mapo-gu, this Turkish Halal Doner Kebab Cafe is a few steps away from the bustling streets of Hongdae. This is a hidden gem for anyone looking for authentic Middle Eastern tastes in Seoul.

It has a cozy and warm atmosphere with warm lighting and unique Turkish charm. The friendly and attentive owner provides comfort to all guests, especially Muslim guests looking for a Halal-certified restaurant.
The food is really great. Perfectly grilled döner kebab is tender and rich in flavor, served with soft bread and fresh vegetables. The sauce adds just the right amount of spiciness without overpowering the taste of the meat. The portions are generous, so every time you take a bite, you'll feel as if you're experiencing the taste of Istanbul in the middle of Korea.

Whether you're exploring Hongdae or looking for authentic halal food, this cafe is a must-visit. I definitely want to visit again because it’s a delicious, friendly, and sincere place! 🇹🇷❤️🇰🇷

reviews.text:
Kyochon Chicken store located near the Seogyo-dong intersection in Hongdae

Kyochon Chicken Hongdae branch boasts a fairly large two-story store, and there were a lot of visitors when I visited on a weekend evening. What was special was that there were so many foreign tourists, and this was the first time I realized that Korea's Kyochon Chicken was so popular among foreigners!

Tables for two people were turned around quickly, so I was ushered to the second floor as soon as I entered. Perhaps because there were a lot of customers, the chicken came out a bit quickly. It was nice that I could pay with a KakaoTalk gifticon, and since I didn't have the red combo, I ate red boneless meat and it was delicious.

What was disappointing was that the amount of egg fried rice was really small compared to the price, and a cup of cola was 2,500 won. It was a little disappointing that the water went down in the urinal in the men's bathroom and the smell was really bad!
